intro.label: About me
intro.title: I design and build
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer in training at Universidad de las Fuerzas Armadas ESPE in Ecuador. I combine a solid academic foundation with hands-on experience building real-world applications.

I combine modern frontend —scalable Angular architectures, accessible interfaces and Flutter apps— with automation and systems integration: CRMs, Meta APIs and AI assistants built on RAG. Every project is an opportunity to learn something new.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me reading about software architecture, contributing to open source or experimenting with new technologies.
